result.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
result.summary: Distilling capable language-model agents into smaller models requires aligning the student's behavior with the teacher's. This raises a fundamental question: at which states and at what granularity should this alignment be performed? Offline imitation provides dense but token-specific supervision and can suffer from state-distribution mismatch. Token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this mismatch but typically requires teacher token probabilities and compatible tokenization. We argue that semantic actions provide a natural unit of supervision for agent distillation. We introduce ActionOPD, an action-level on-policy distillation method motivated by maximizing expected teacher-action likelihood at student-encountered states. At each such state, ActionOPD samples actions from both the student and a black-box teacher, rewarding student actions according to their semantic agreement with the sampled teacher actions. Through policy optimization, ActionOPD aligns the student's action-level behavior with the teacher's decisions without requiring reproduction of teacher-written reasoning or access to teacher token probabilities. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with two teachers on diverse, curated tool-use tasks yields average gains of 3.3-6.9 percentage points across four out-of-distribution benchmarks. ActionOPD scales favorably with student size and teacher capability, without requiring the teacher and student to share a model family or tokenizer. On $τ^2$-bench, ActionOPD achieves competitive performance against offline distillation and token-level OPD. We further explore Self-ActionOPD with a same-model teacher and privileged context. These results establish ActionOPD as a promising approach to agent distillation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ActionOPD，一种面向语言模型智能体的动作级 on-policy 蒸馏方法：在学生实际遇到的状态上分别从学生与黑盒教师采样动作，按语义一致性给予奖励并做策略优化，从而无需教师 token 概率或同族分词器即可对齐学生决策，在多个工具使用基准上取得 3.3–6.9 个百分点的平均提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态 latent 推理无直接关系，但其「以语义动作而非 token 为监督单元、在学生遇到的状态上做 on-policy 对齐」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步的监督粒度、轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。
